candidate_classes_tested.basis: Recording, account recovery, database access and model routing contain no preserved intimacy-bearing identity claim, privileged-care assertion or real-world partner priority. Privacy or source substitution is not automatically relational-authority distortion; no affirmative escalation response supports success.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: Privacy/consent interests are evidenced, but the occurrence does not jointly preserve a specific heightened personal influence/support duty, reasonably available risk signals in that governed interaction and materially omitted protective response. Ordinary security and permission mechanisms remain independent. Neither harm nor the absence of a response establishes nonactivation.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: DeepSeek secured the exposed database after Wiz notified the company. That action repaired the reported public access state. The result covers closure of the exposure. It does not establish recovery of any data already accessed.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Closure of the exposed AI service database directly identifies repair of an unwanted security state.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Wiz directly accessed unauthenticated chat histories and secrets in DeepSeek’s database. Personal AI interaction data was publicly accessible without an access gate. That exposure did not preserve privacy and data protection. Earlier access by other parties remains unproved.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The public exposure of personal chat histories directly engages privacy and data protection.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: Wiz found internet-reachable endpoints with no authentication and full database control. The AI service’s surrounding infrastructure exposed chats, API secrets and operational data. This security outcome is Not aligned. It does not establish compromise of model weights or earlier third-party misuse.
retained_rows.identification_basis: Unauthenticated database-operation access directly engages security of the AI service and its operational infrastructure.

external_requirements.coverage_disposition: Independent privacy/security/repair results retained at their stated evidence objects and attribution limits. Mathspace’s prior full external audit excludes AI-specific objects for a conventional database; ordinary student-data/cyber requirements remain a standards registry coverage question, not a fabricated AI requirement or omitted personal-support class.
